evals.prompt: Our app already has a shadcn sidebar shell with a top bar. Lay out the dashboard's content area for project managers: late projects, four headline figures, a trend of completed tasks, and recent activity.
assertions: Looks for the existing shell, width caps, and gutters before proposing values, or says which it could not find
Names a dashboard template and at least one alternative with a reason it lost
Writes the grid as base, gutters, cap, key lines, and template, and says where it is recorded (DESIGN.md or AGENTS.md)
Puts the cap and gutters on one container and gives no section its own horizontal padding
Sizes the figure row by container width, not viewport breakpoints, and avoids a lone figure on a second row
States what changes at 768 and 390, and either cites a capture or marks widths unverified instead of estimating pixel widths

evals.prompt: In our members list the avatar, name, role, and the row menu sit at different x positions from row to row, because each row is a flex container with its own content widths. Fix the row layout.
assertions: Gives the leading avatar slot and the trailing role or menu slots fixed widths, with a flexible middle that can shrink (minmax(0, 1fr) or min-width: 0)
Defines the tracks once for every row (a shared grid template or subgrid) rather than per row
Keeps slot sizes and gaps on the 4px grid
Keeps an empty slot's width when a row has no avatar, so the text stays on one line
Verifies with a capture or the xray command, or says the alignment is unverified

evals.prompt: Lay out a settings page with three groups: workspace details, notifications, and a danger zone. It must work from a wide desktop down to 390px.
assertions: Puts each group's heading in a left column and its fields in a right column on wide screens, and stacks them in one column when narrow
Caps the fields (about 560 to 720px) so inputs do not stretch across a wide screen
Places the danger zone last, separated, with each action naming its consequence
Gives a group a description only when it says something the heading cannot, rather than a description under every heading
Saves per group or with a bar that appears on change, rather than one save far from its fields

evals.prompt: Our pages use max-w-6xl on two pages, max-w-7xl on three, and no cap on settings, and every section sets its own px-6. Make widths and gutters consistent.
assertions: Counts the existing caps by page type and keeps the most common value per type instead of inventing a new one
Moves the cap and gutters to one shared container and removes the per-section padding
Gives settings a narrower cap suited to forms rather than the data cap
Records the result once in DESIGN.md or AGENTS.md
Verifies across routes with the interface-craft capture or routes command, or marks it unverified
